_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); revenue, margin, expense and receivables signals with Google's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'Google is a global technology leader focused on improving the ways people connect with information.' 'We generate our revenues almost entirely from advertising, and the reduction in spending by or loss of advertisers could seriously harm our business.' 'We face formidable competition in every aspect of our business, particularly from companies that seek to connect people with information on the web and provide them with relevant advertising.' 'As our growth rate has slowed, the cyclicality and seasonality in our business has become more pronounced and caused our operating results to fluctuate.' 'In addition, expenditures by advertisers tend to be cyclical, reflecting overall economic conditions and budgeting and buying patterns.' (FY2011 10-K); CYCLICAL: the 10-K says so of its own business ('the cyclicality and seasonality in our business'), the BKR, CAT and NVDA reading, not an industry's words; no theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a search and advertising company on these dates (OFFSHORE is scoped to IT services), so the watch list is empty; the competition named is a competitive field, not a theme, and stays here (the PEP obesity rule)

BEAR.desc: EPS -8.9%/yr (worst year FY02-FY11, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +31.0%/yr (Q2 revenue YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 8.1-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +59.3%/yr (FY02-FY11 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +249.9%/yr (best 2-yr run FY02-FY11, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: GOOG (retrospective, 2012-10-05) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.14x (41.1% downside to Bear $452.01 / +304.4% upside to Bull $3104.69) | Adj composite 1.84 vs market 1.22: gap +0.62 [UNDERVALUED] | +36% above the EPP floor $565.44 (19x FY12E $29.76) | Conservative 2-yr case: +106.5% total (+53.2%/yr) | At 25.8x FY12E the 15% hurdle price $1,015.22 sits at or below the BASE case; revenue +35.3% YoY in Q2 2012, forward revenues +35.3% (Q2 2012 revenue growth (no Q3 2012 guide)); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
